mechanism.name: Li：辅助总体IV数据融合机制

sampling.unit: 从两个总体合并而来的独立个体；R=0没有观测IV
sampling.dependence: iid individuals from the merged population; R selects the target or auxiliary population. Z is observed only when R=1; Z_obs=0 is a masked slot when R=0, not an observed target-population instrument. U is latent.

assumptions: 一致性、潜在可忽略性；R=1中的条件IV独立/排除/相关；U⊥R|V；§2结构均值与equi-confounding限制；总体选择/处理正性

properties.notes: Four active V components; expit(2V-1) transformations, heterogeneous treatment by V and R, product (2-R+...)*(1+X). IV recorded only for R=1; zero-filled slot with mask R is observation encoding, not exposure of missing Z. Baseline-dimension convention: p=4, effective_p=4, baseline_columns=['V1', 'V2', 'V3', 'V4']; instruments, posttreatment variables, time points and network nodes are excluded. Reference sample size n_ref=128 independent subjects (the CPU interface-check setting), p/n_ref=0.03125000; high_dimensional=false refers to baseline p in this stated setting, not the full observed-column count. n remains a runtime argument; reassess the dimension/sample-size regime if n or p changes rather than treating this tag as a guarantee for arbitrary scaling.

truth.derivation: Target R=0 ATE from E[(1-p_R(V))*tau(V)]/E[1-p_R(V)]; Gauss-Hermite80/96 with independent Legendre96/112 convergence diagnostics, plus actual-sampler interventions and threshold tests.

adaptations: Use explicitly read v1 DGP; 2026 journal bibliographic status does not imply line-by-line matching with version of record.
Encode missing IV as Z_obs=0 when R=0 and supply R as the observation mask; never output the true unobserved IV.
Numerically integrate the exact population target instead of using source rounded value2.22 as exact truth; fit misspecification variants are not new DGPs.
